transfers.input: TransferInput: parent_node, Blob file, optional filename, MIME, replaces, checksum, resume session and offset
transfers.scope: Drive-selected opaque context for destination and replacement node
transfers.effects: Session creation updates root usage; successful finish reconciles the node and invalidates children, views and root usage through generated Drive mutations.
transfers.error_handling: Rejects failure or AbortError; observes pending, progress, error and cancellation. Queue owns inline feedback with silent transfer calls.
transfers.removal_condition: Retained owner workflow until the upload protocol is replaced; ordinary session calls use generated references.
